# Codex IDE VS Code Extension - Development Instructions

## Project Overview
Building a professional VS Code extension for Codex IDE that enables code analysis, completion, and IDE features directly in VS Code.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md file
- [ ] Scaffold VS Code extension project with TypeScript
- [ ] Customize with Codex IDE features
- [ ] Install required VS Code extension tools
- [ ] Verify compilation and dependencies
- [ ] Create development tasks (build, debug, watch)
- [ ] Finalize documentation and README

## Project Structure
```
codex-ide-extension/
├── src/
│   ├── extension.ts
│   ├── commands/
```
